definitions.text: The angle between the pedicle axis and a line parallel to the vertebral axis in the transverse plane. The vertebral axis bisects the angle between lines joining the posterior junction of both laminae (a) to a point on each medial cortical wall where the lamina meets the pedicle (b and c). The transverse pedicle angle is between the pedicle axis p1–p2 and a line parallel to the vertebral axis p2–p3 on the concave side (Figure 2).

Twenty-four AIS patients, curves <100°, 14 female and 10 male; mean age 14.6 years (12.3–18.3), mean Cobb 76° (58–98°); King II 12, King III 7, King IV 5. [own inference] Convex is read as right and concave as left because all 24 patients had right thoracic/thoracolumbar curves; the paper does not explicitly equate convex with right.
